sections.headline: You are welcome here
sections.content:
*This is more than an invitation — it's a calling*

There are many ways to belong to Essência. Whether you're ready to put down roots, offer your hands for a season, or simply support what's growing here — there's a place for you.

columns.headline: Become a Resident
columns.description: Live on the land, share meals, and co-create a way of life that is regenerative and deeply alive. Residency is a commitment — to the community, and to your own becoming. Available full-time or part-time, depending on where you are in life.
columns.tags: Heal & grow — Morning practices — Community — Build your home — Life in nature

columns.headline: Volunteer with Us
columns.description: Join us for a season of meaningful work. Choose one area or immerse in all. In return, receive nourishment, a place to rest, and space to heal and grow.
columns.tags: Heal & grow — Morning practices — Community — Land & garden — Building — Cooking — Spaces & accommodations

columns.headline: Become a Friend
columns.description: Believe in what we're building? Support Essência and receive gifts from the land — from a tree planted in your name to a weekend in our glamping. A way to belong, wherever you are.
columns.tags: Heal & grow — Morning practices — Community — Gifts from the land — Retreat access — Glamping stays
